shadows.name: preview-paper
shadows.purpose: Quietly lift the sample document comparison from the paper canvas.

shadows.name: menu-soft
shadows.purpose: Separate the command menu from the page while open.

motion.name: classical-illustration
motion.value: Static, responsive inline SVG with no animation loop
motion.purpose: Keep the Parthenon line art clear and quiet behind the hero copy.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The main application action, confident but quiet.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #A88A5C; border-radius: 8px; background: #17364A; color: #FBF9F3; font: 500 14px Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #24485C; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A88A5C; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A quiet route to product details and navigation.
components.css: .ds-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #344957; font: 500 14px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-secondary:hover { color: #17364A; background: rgba(168,138,92,.08); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A88A5C; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Document Preview
components.description: An honest sample of the resume-to-role comparison.
components.html:
Example review

Resume details compared with a target role.
components.css: .ds-preview { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #DED4C2; border-radius: 12px; background: #FBF9F3; color: #1D2B36; box-shadow: 0 30px 54px -42px rgba(23,54,74,.2); font: 400 14px/1.7 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-preview strong { font: 400 24px/1.2 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif; } .ds-preview p { color: #536873; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet section navigation with a fine active underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { color: #344957; text-decoration: none; font: 500 13px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-nav:hover, .ds-nav[aria-current='location'] { color: #17364A; } .ds-nav[aria-current='location'] { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #A88A5C; text-underline-offset: 8px; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A88A5C; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A Greek classic editorial system across landing, workspace, admin, and dialogs: limestone paper, Aegean navy, olive, aged bronze, DM Serif Display, and Manrope. A Parthenon line illustration, laurel crown, and small lightning mark define the hero.
keyCharacteristics: Parthenon, laurel crown, and meander rule

rules.name: The Aegean Palette Rule
rules.body: Use navy for action, bronze for fine emphasis, and olive for positive states; keep contrast readable on limestone.

rules.name: The Classical Voice Rule
rules.body: Use DM Serif Display for headlines and Manrope for body text and controls.

rules.name: The Classical Architecture Rule
rules.body: Use the Parthenon line illustration as the hero focal point and keep Greek motifs restrained.

dos: Do give the document comparison room to breathe.
Do use short sections and warm whitespace.
donts: Don't use unrelated brand copy or fictional partner logos.
Don't add remote raster assets without verified rights.
